capabilities: Show one day of Outlook events in a sidebar
Drag or insert events into notes as Markdown lines
Insert the whole day's agenda by command
Follow the open daily note's date
Mark event lines in the editor and jump to them in the panel
disambiguation: Not a calendar editor; it only reads Outlook events and never creates, changes or answers anything in Outlook.
extras: Read-only access via Microsoft Graph delegated permission Calendars.Read; device code sign-in, which some organisations block. Shared calendars may need Calendars.Read.Shared. Last seven fetched days cached in Obsidian local storage; token in Obsidian secret storage. Not affiliated with Microsoft.
problem: Outlook calendar events are not visible while writing in Obsidian, so adding them to a daily note means switching apps and retyping details.

relations.evidence: Already use the Microsoft To Do Panel plugin? You can reuse its app registration

requires.name: Microsoft account with an Outlook calendar
Microsoft Entra app registration (client ID, tenant)

summary: Sidebar panel that shows one day of your Outlook calendar and inserts events into notes as Markdown lines.
